# DNS (`dns`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [Application protocols](../../protocols/app.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 53 (0x0035) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uint(16)` | `4660` |   | Query identifier, copied into the response. |
| `qr` | `enum(1)` | `0` (query) |   | Query (0) or response (1). |
| `opcode` | `enum(4)` | `0` (query) |   | Kind of query (0 = standard query, 4 = NOTIFY, 5 = UPDATE). |
| `aa` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Authoritative answer flag. |
| `tc` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Truncation flag. |
| `rd` | `uint(1)` | `1` |   | Recursion desired flag. |
| `ra` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Recursion available flag. |
| `z` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Reserved bit (must be 0). |
| `ad` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Authentic data flag (DNSSEC). |
| `cd` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | Checking disabled flag (DNSSEC). |
| `rcode` | `enum(4)` | `0` (no_error) |   | Response code (0 = NOERROR, 3 = NXDOMAIN, ...). |
| `qdcount` | `uint(16)` | `1` |   | Number of entries in the question section. |
| `ancount` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Number of resource records in the answer section. |
| `nscount` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Number of resource records in the authority section. |
| `arcount` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Number of resource records in the additional section. |
| `sections` | `bytes` — rest of the PDU | `07 65 78 61 6d 70 6c 65 03 63 6f 6d 00 00 01 00 01` |   | Question / answer / authority / additional sections (length-prefixed label names); opaque octets. |

### `qr`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `query` |
| 1 | `response` |

### `opcode`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `query` |
| 1 | `iquery` |
| 2 | `status` |
| 4 | `notify` |
| 5 | `update` |

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `no_error` |
| 1 | `format_error` |

| 3 | `nx_domain` |
| 4 | `not_implemented` |
| 5 | `refused` |
